name: fin-news-flash — InvestingLive every 30s → queue

nodes.name: Cron — every 30s (InvestingLive flash)
nodes.notes: 30s matches InvestingLive RSS refresh (~30-60s). Lean poll → prefilter → DB+queue only. Does NOT post to Discord; queue_worker drains next.

parameters.notes: flock -n = skip if previous poll still running. Enqueues high/medium to flash_queue pending, low to skipped. ~<2s, FREE only.
Single-flight FIFO drain: one pending → FREE embed → DISCORD_FLASH_WEBHOOK_URL → done. If busy, next tick picks it up. Paid hook stub inside queue_worker.

notes: Deploy: Import to n8n (Settings → Import from File). Keep fin-news-assistant n8n-workflow.json daily 08:00 digest separate. This flash workflow handles 30s live news only (investinglive). Prefilter saves paid tokens, flash_queue guarantees no loss when agent busy.
